Заселение агентов на борт.\n\n• ИМЯ — ка:
Boarding agents on the ship.

• NAME — what to call the agent.
• RIGHTS are granted here, at boarding, with buttons: CREW (conversation only),
  OBSERVER (reading and reports), COMMANDER (full rights, asks before acting).
  On board, rights are not changed — only a new boarding changes them.
• An ordinary pilot does not get Commander rights just like that: the ship's owner
  grants them with the owner code. If there is no code yet, it is set here once.
• MANNERS — the ship's document: the pilot writes the agent's behaviour himself and
  edits it at any time.
• VOICE — the ship reads the answer aloud / the agent speaks itself / silent.
• MODEL — empty = the default OpenCode model.
• “SAVE” — board or change, “MAKE ACTIVE” — whom to talk to,
  “REMOVE FROM SHIP” — drop the passenger.
• The ship itself limits the rights: “Crew” has neither files nor commands.
